title: The Fountain With a Past

hints.text: Enter the newer Haunted Mansion grounds and watch for a familiar water feature near the start of the expanded queue.
It is a Spanish-style fountain that was reused rather than created only for this garden.
Find the Spanish fountain near the entrance to the expanded Haunted Mansion grounds.

revealDescription: The Spanish-style fountain in the expanded Haunted Mansion queue previously stood in the nearby area that became Magnolia Park.
